pkgmetadata.longdescription: Wazuh is a free, open source and enterprise-ready security monitoring solution for threat detection, integrity monitoring, incident response and compliance.

use.flag: Link to the system audit daemon to monitor system events.
Translate the IP address to a geographical approximate location.
Add support for real time FIM (File Integrity Monitoring).
Use the high performance jemalloc memory allocator.
Add support to safely containerize the agent's behavior and to allow the agent to read sensitive files.
Build the deprecated CIS-CAT module used for audit/evaluate compliants against CIS benchmarks.
Build the Syscollector module for gathering system info (hardware specs, running process, installed processes)
